child.text:
[{"insert":"Seated Strict Press + Push Up

This is a super set for the shoulders and chest. The seated strict press takes the legs out of it so the shoulders do all the overhead work, then you move straight into push ups while already fatigued. Keep the press strict with no leg drive and hold a tight body line on the push ups. Push both close to failure each round.
"}]
